# loading libraries
```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(rio)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(Metrics)
```


# import dataset
```{r}
set.seed(123)
n<-500
HouseSize <-round(rnorm(n, 1800, 400))

Bedrooms<- sample(2:6,n, replace=TRUE)

Bathrooms<- sample(1:4, n, replace=TRUE)

Age<-sample(1:50, n, replace=TRUE)

Garage<-sample(0:3, n, replace=TRUE)

DistancedCBD<- round(runif(n, 2,30),1)

CrimeRate<- round(runif(n, 10,80),1)

SchoolRating<-sample(1:10, n, replace=TRUE)

LotSize<- round(rnorm(n, 600, 120))

HousePrice<- 5000+HouseSize*180+Bedrooms*12000+Bathrooms*15000-Age*1500+Garage*8000
              -DistancedCBD*2500-CrimeRate*900+SchoolRating*10000
              +LotSize*60+rnorm(n,0,25000)

housing_data<-data.frame(HouseSize, Bedrooms, Bathrooms,
                          Age, Garage, DistancedCBD, CrimeRate,
                         SchoolRating, LotSize, HousePrice)
head(housing_data)
```



# explore data set
```{r}
str(housing_data)
```

## confirm for missing values
```{r}
colSums(is.na(housing_data))
```
## split data into training and testing 
```{r}
split_index<-createDataPartition(housing_data$HousePrice, p=0.8, list=FALSE)
train<-housing_data[split_index, ]
test<-housing_data[-split_index, ]
```

## create a training matrix
```{r}
train_x<-as.matrix(train[, 1:9])
test_x<-as.matrix(test[, 1:9])
train_y<-train$HousePrice
test_y<-test$HousePrice
```


### converty to Dmatrix
```{r}
dtrain<-xgb.DMatrix(
  data=train_x,
  label = train_y
)
dtest<-xgb.DMatrix(
  data=test_x,
  label=test_y
)
```


## train xgboost model
```{r}
params<- list(
  objective="reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric="rmse",
  eta=0.10,
  max.depth=5,
  subsample= 0.8,
  colsample_bytree=0.8
  
)
xgb_model<-xgb.train(
  params=params,
  data=dtrain,
  nrounds=150,
  watchlist=list(train=dtrain),
  verbose=1
  )
```

## predict house price
```{r}
predic<-predict(xgb_model,
                dtest)
head(predic)
```



## model evaluation
```{r}
rmse_value<-rmse(test_y, predic)
mae_value<-mae(test_y, predic)
mse_value<-mse(test_y, predic)
r2<-cor(test_y, predic)^2
cat("rmse:",rmse_value,"\n")
cat("mae",mae_value,"\n")
mse_value
r2
```


# scatter plot of actual vs predicted
```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(
  Actual=test_y, predicted=predic
),aes(
  Actual, predicted
))+
  geom_point(color="yellowgreen", alpha=0.7)+
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour="red", linewidth=1, linetype="dotted")+
  theme_minimal()
```




# feature importance 
```{r}
importance<-xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(train_x),
model=xgb_model
)
importance
```


### feature importance plot
```{r}
xgb.plot.importance(
  importance_matrix=importance
)
```



### predict new instance
```{r}
new_house<-matrix(c(2200, 4,3, 8, 2, 10, 20, 8, 700),nrow=1)
new_house<- xgb.DMatrix(new_house)
cat("predicted house model:",predict(xgb_model, new_house))
```
